§6Storage Tablet§f

§aCarry your entire storage network in your pocket, or just use it as a portable chest.§f

The §bStorage Tablet§f has two modes:
§b• Local Card§f: Insert a Storage Card to use it as a standalone portable chest. Costs §e100 RF§f per open, plus §e100 RF per tier§f extra.
§b• Wireless Network§f: Insert a linked §bStorage Control Library Module§f + §bWireless Network Card§f to access your Storage Scanner from anywhere.

§6Wireless Costs§f:
§b• Same dimension§f: §e10 RF/t§f while connected
§b• Cross-dimension§f: §e50 RF/t§f while connected

§bBuffer§f: §e20,000 RF§f, charges at §e500 RF/t§f.

§cWARNING:§f Interdimensional access drains power fast. If your base's grid falters, the link drops and items in transit may be lost.
